description: A published document: one per (content type, uid, locale). The rkey is `<lang>-<uid>`. `data` holds the type's field values and is validated against the ing.lexicon.cms.type record, so the lexicon keeps it open.

type.description: The content-type key this document instantiates.

publication.description: The site (site.standard.publication) this document belongs to. Multisite: one DID, many publications.

data.description: Values for the type's fields, validated against ing.lexicon.cms.type.

alternates.description: The same document in other locales.

bodyBlob.description: When the inline body would be too large for the PDS, the JSON-encoded slice array is uploaded here and `body` is left empty/a stub. Consumers MUST prefer `bodyBlob` when set. Mirrors Leaflet's pub.leaflet.content#blobPages.

blobs.description: Blob refs living inside bodyBlob. The PDS GC scans only a record's top level, so any blob now inside the opaque bodyBlob JSON must be mirrored here to stay referenced.
